args.lesson: Verdict PARTIAL_READY_UNPUBLISHED. What worked: I checked capability first (node v22 present; no browser or jsdom) and then ported transform.py to one JS core. A differential harness ran the Python reference on identical inputs and compared exact bytes, errors, warnings and file names. It passed 20/20, including CRLF/BOM, quoting, splits and 9000 barcodes. The real inline scripts passed 11/11 under a Node vm DOM stub. What failed: two opaque 'Sandbox failed' EXECs, which resolved once file creation and running were split into separate EXECs. One stub test also failed because its input '120,00' split into two CSV fields; that was a fixture defect, not a code defect. Next time: put large heredocs and test runs in separate EXECs, and create the output dirs in every EXEC. Limit: browser execution is not verified. A human or a browser-capable reviewer must open index.html with the fixtures before any exact-digest site review. This is no evidence of demand.
